E4.spliceai_command: spliceai -I e4.vcf -O e4.spliceai.vcf -R hg38.fa -A grch38 (-D 50 = package default; max |DP| in output = 50; every scored gene span in spliceai/annotations/grch38.txt covers its variant), SLURM job 3700, -p low -w sblxa123c, CPU only

deviations: E3 95% intervals: cluster bootstrap over (species, gene) (2,000 resamples, seed 0) because OMIA rows carry no exon/element ID; PLAN asks for exons/elements.

E3 groups: 'other' = extension (stop-lost) 1 + missing variant_effect 1; synonymous group has 0 SNVs in the scored OMIA set (1 synonymous variant exists in the raw OMIA cache but not among the 372 scored dog/cat/chicken SNVs).

E4 MAGI strict status: the 62-row CSV has only the primary NT_Mechanism, so NT_All_Mechanisms and D_BED_* were joined 1:1 from the saved SNV mechanism table s4_snv_mechanism_assignments.csv on (VariationID, chrom, pos, ref, alt); 62/62 matched. Strict (tier 0-3, PLAN definition) = 62/62, agreeing with the primary-based status on 62/62.
E4 SpliceAI unscored rows kept as NA (not 0) in e4_scores.csv and counted separately.
Pangolin not run (not installed; see setup notes).

E4 rating scheme: raters used 5 classes (lab_rna_or_minigene, prediction_only, negated_or_inconclusive, functional_other, no_splice_claim) instead of PLAN's 3; for the candidate definition every class other than lab_rna_or_minigene counts as 'no lab RNA evidence'. Kappa on PLAN's 3 classes (functional_other -> no_splice_claim) is reported beside it for both placements of negated_or_inconclusive.

E4 Cohen's kappa CI: bootstrap over rated variants (2,000) and exact Clopper-Pearson intervals for fractions are variant-level; PLAN's cluster bootstrap over exons applies to model performance and the rater unit is the variant. Gene-cluster bootstrap intervals are reported beside them for fractions and AUROC (no exon IDs in the 62-row set, so genes are the clusters). Each bootstrap now draws from its own generator (seed 0), so intervals no longer depend on code order; this shifted some gene-bootstrap intervals slightly from the first report.

E4 annotation flag: VEP 116 (vepyr, GENCODE 50) splice flags reported beside the PLAN GENCODE v44 flag, as any splice term and as the PLAN-window terms (splice_region, splice_donor_region, splice_donor_5th_base, splice_donor, splice_acceptor). The first report's 'PLAN-equivalent' splice_region|donor|acceptor left out splice_donor_region_variant (intron +3 to +6) and is kept only for reference. With the PLAN-window terms the flags agree on 61/62; the one VEP-only case is SRD5A2 1298365 (splice_donor_region_variant on a GENCODE 50 transcript, not flagged by the v44 PLAN flag).
E4 ascertainment check (added after audit): per-class counts of rationales that mention splicing or cite an in-silico splice prediction, from FullRationale; only boolean flags are written out.
caveats: omia.org unreachable from compute node sblxa123c (job 3702: curl timed out after 30 s for both the phene page and the results table). OMIA evidence comes from the offline cache data/omia_raw_variants.csv (c., p., Verbal Description, PMIDs, year) and data/*_variants.parquet rationale.

OMIA rule calls are on non-human genomes; SpliceAI, CADD and the GENCODE annotation flag are hg38-only, so they are not applicable to E3 candidates. The exon-end offset is read from the OMIA HGVS c. string as written.

SNX14 (OMIA variant 415) c. string is 'c.26531G>A' in the OMIA cache, which is implausible for SNX14 cDNA (possibly c.2653+1G>A with the '+' lost). Reported as found and classed 'no intron offset (exonic)'; not corrected.
E3 has no negatives (all OMIA variants are disease variants), so rates are descriptive only.

E4 dist_gencode is the signed setup-script distance to the nearest internal exon end in any GENCODE v44 transcript (sign not strand-aware and unreliable: TMEM67 and TIMM44 are exonic yet positive); bp_to_nearest_MANE_exon_end is unsigned MANE-only, kept beside it. All 62 are annot_region=exonic. 5/62 are annotation-flagged only through non-MANE GENCODE transcripts (e.g. KRIT1 5726: 3 bp in GENCODE, 115 bp in MANE).

E4 MAGI strict = 62/62 by construction (the input file is MAGI's splice calls away from MANE exon ends), so 'AND MAGI strict call' filters nothing. The lab fraction 25/62 = 0.40 is a floor on the precision of these calls, not a precision: at least 25/62 have lab RNA/minigene confirmation, at most 6/62 are ClinVar Benign (all in no_splice_claim), and the other 31 are of unknown splice status.

E4 SpliceAI d500 sensitivity uses the precomputed MANE set (SpliceAI 1.3.1, distance 500, masked); the d50 run (job 3700, GRCh38 package annotation) is unmasked. d50-vs-d500 differences (3 ge->lt, 2 unscored->ge) mix distance, masking and transcript set.
E4 ratings come from ClinVar submitter rationales; absence of lab evidence in a rationale is not evidence of no splice effect. 25/25 lab-confirmed variants are Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic.

E4 ascertainment: submitters order RNA/minigene assays mostly after a splice predictor flags the variant. 20/25 lab rationales also cite an in-silico splice prediction (regex in E4_ratings.rationale_regex_in_silico); 0/9 functional_other and 1/14 no_splice_claim rationales mention splicing at all. So (a) '0 candidates' (lab AND SpliceAI < 0.2) has almost no power by design and is not evidence that MAGI lacks signal independent of SpliceAI; (b) the lab-vs-rest contrasts and AUROCs are confounded by test selection and are not head-to-head accuracy. Lab vs (functional_other or no_splice_claim) is close to 'did the rationale discuss splicing at all'.

E4 rater provenance, as relayed: final.json holds the adjudicated classes; rater_A/B.json are rebuilt by ratings/make_raw.py from final.json plus the relayed differences. No rater prompt, blinding protocol, adjudication record or raw rater output is saved. final equals rater A on 61/62 and rater B on 61/62. The claim 'two independent blind raters with adjudication' cannot be verified from saved files; kappa and raw agreement are computed from the relayed ratings.

E4 clusters are genes (the 62-row set has no exon IDs). Genes with >1 variant: NF1 6 (6 lab), ABCA4 3 (0 lab), KRIT1 2 (2 lab), BRAF 2 (0 lab), PTEN 2 (1 lab), HBB 2 (2 lab), CDH1 2 (2 lab), BRCA1 2 (1 lab), BTK 2 (1 lab). The gene bootstrap resamples whole genes. Gene-bootstrap intervals for 0/n are degenerate [0,0]; Clopper-Pearson intervals are beside them.

E4 MAGI continuous splice score (PLAN definition) counts losses only (max of -D_BED over exon, always_on_exon, splice_donor, splice_acceptor), so gain-triggered calls score low (e.g. 99421 ABERRANT_EXON_INCLUSION from always_on_exon=+0.227 scores 0.038). Its AUROC is also computed on a set MAGI called 100% of the time (restricted range), so it says little about MAGI's discrimination in general.
E4 SpliceAI d50 unscored (3): SRD5A2 1298365 and PLP1 930478 (genes absent from the package grch38.txt), BTK 402436 (chrX:101390479 lies outside the package BTK span 101349449-101386195).
E4 AVI (AlphaGenome Variant Impact) is a general impact score under the AlphaGenome Output Terms (non-commercial); reported descriptively only.
exploratory: EXPLORATORY: strict-call rate in nonsense SNVs (13/82 = 0.1585, gene-bootstrap 95% CI 0.0864-0.2353) is about the same as in splice-annotated SNVs (8/49 = 0.1633, 0.0638-0.2778); 11 of the 13 nonsense calls have primary CODING_LOSS or EXON_LOSS. In OMIA the strict call does not separate splice from nonsense variants.

EXPLORATORY: splice-annotated OMIA SNVs by HGVS c. offset: canonical +/-1-2: strict 4/28, loose 21/28; intronic other: strict 1/11, loose 4/11; no c. string: strict 0/1, loose 0/1; no intron offset (exonic): strict 3/9, loose 6/9. The 4 strict calls at canonical +1 donors (ADAMTS17, ANO6, SLC37A2, KRT71) and the +5 donor call (COL17A1) all have a GAIN primary (SPLICE_INDUCED_EXONIZATION or CRYPTIC_SPLICE_GAIN), not donor loss; 17/28 canonical +/-1-2 variants get only tier-4 SPLICE_CHANGE/EXON_CHANGE.

EXPLORATORY: of the 8 splice-annotated candidates, MOCOS and XDH have cDNA-described whole-exon skipping in the OMIA text (Tate et al. 2021, PMID 34584846), both at exonic positions (c.232G>T, c.654G>A), and MAGI primary SPLICE_SITE_DESTROYED (tier 0) with EXON_LOSS among secondaries.
EXPLORATORY: E4 MAGI continuous splice score (PLAN definition) median 0.3515 over the 62; 11 of the 59 SpliceAI-scored variants have SpliceAI < 0.2, all annotation-silent.

EXPLORATORY: E4 ratings AUROC, lab_vs_all_other: spliceai_d50 0.8871 (0.799-0.9609, n=59, lab=25); spliceai_d500_mane 0.8811 (0.7859-0.9519, n=61, lab=25); magi_continuous_splice_score (losses only) 0.6205 (0.4571-0.7562, n=62, lab=25); magi_abs_delta_max (gain or loss, 4 D_BED tracks) 0.6573 (0.468-0.8135, n=62, lab=25); avi_raw_score (general impact, not splice) 0.6832 (0.5417-0.8125, n=62, lab=25). Confounded by test selection (see the E4 ascertainment caveat); not head-to-head accuracy.
